source: User request; map generator review; previously inspected player exports and 500 baseline bot runs on 0.274.0.
basis: Campaign scaling, rules 114: Tier I 105/98 -> 100/95 HP/damage; Tier XII 655/197 -> 700/250 before category premiums. Linear slopes 50/9 -> 600/11 and 155/11 pp, rounded per row; legacy stage offsets/rows retained. Elites x1.25/x1.08 -> x1.30/x1.12; Wardens x1.20/x1.15 -> x1.35/x1.18. Normal effective Tier I: Elite130/106, Warden135/112; Tier XII: Elite910/280, Warden945/295. Saved maps remain; existing runs adopt scaling and unfinished battle logs restart through existing rules migration. Arena values unchanged. Earlier rules113/11-floor simulations do not evaluate this candidate.
evaluationScope: All30 Ascendancies, ten starts and mixed builds reviewed. Early Elite effective HP130/damage106 vs prior131/106; early Warden135/112 vs126/113. XII Warden945/295 vs786/227: +20.2% HP and +30.0% attack multiplier. Existing phase buffs can compound pressure. These are hand calculations, not measured survival or parity. Earlier 500 rules113 11-floor attempts are historical; no current-candidate simulations.
target: Typical Arena games of 10 or more own turns and roughly 50% or better Drago clears with optimized decks remain playtest targets.
